about: Hand calls recorded before the per-case provision review, to validate tools/check_evidence.py. A call is present when the provision text (the first citation's, as shipped then) carries the evidence that the pre-fix module is wrong, so a judge given provision.txt and pre_fix.yaml could detect the defect, and absent otherwise. The provision review has since settled every case; tests/test_real_defects_corpus.py recomputes each set's agreement with the review's verdicts (present against in_provision), and the README reports it.

sets.name: review_round2
sets.labeller: the 2026-10-03 round-two reviewer of PR #1659 (Claude, read-only), by grepping each provision for the phrase the case's pre_fix_wrong_because cites
sets.role: calibration: in-sample. The first version of the method agreed on 12 of 15; it was revised after these disagreements were read.

sets.name: blind_round1

sets.role: development: the method was revised after these were scored (17 of 24 before the revision). The evidence fields were written into the case.json files while the labeller worked, and it was told to read only other keys, so blindness is not guaranteed.
